description: This Java class implements the <call-object-method> element for executing a method call on an object within the MiniLang framework, which is part of the Apache OFBiz project. It supports invoking methods on dynamically retrieved objects with specified parameters and handling return values.

classes.name: CallObjectMethod
classes.description: A class that represents the <call-object-method> element, enabling dynamic invocation of a method on a specified object within the MiniLang framework.

classes.name: CallObjectMethod.CallObjectMethodFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating instances of CallObjectMethod from XML elements.

methods.name: CallObjectMethod
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CallObjectMethod instance from an XML element, validating attributes and parsing parameters.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the method call on the target object retrieved from the environment map, using the specified method name and parameters.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the <call-object-method> element with current attribute values.
